name: crash_then_heal
description: Crashes the backend its first `crash_count` starts (raw std::thread null-deref, uncatchable, exactly like raw_thread_crash), tracking the count in a file that survives respawns (XI_QA_RECOVER_MARKER). Once the threshold is reached it returns normally forever, so the backend stays up and the FE supervisor clears the safe state. Used by examples/qa_recover to prove the recover-and-clear transition (FE-E5 / SP4) the always-crashing fe_supervisor can't.

outputs.name: count
outputs.doc: Frames processed on the healed path.

outputs.name: recovered
outputs.doc: 1 once the plugin has stopped crashing.
